# Claude fixtures

`statusline.json` is the `rate_limits` object from the official status-line example at
https://code.claude.com/docs/en/statusline (fetched 31 Oct 2026). Unrelated fields from that
example (workspace, cost, pull request) are omitted. It is documentation JSON, not a capture
from a logged-in session on this machine.

`no-limits.json` is synthetic and has no `rate_limits` object.
